text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Personal Photos Photo requirements: color standard photos, the size is not more than 200kb, support *.jpg, *.jpeg, *.png as the suffix of the picture, pixels greater than 295 * 413. * 2. ID photo(white background) Taken within the last 3 months. * 3. Passport photo page • The validity period must be later than September 1, 2027 • If the applicant is currently in China, both the current visa page and the most recent entry stamp page must be provided 4. Other academic support documents (such as award certificates, other university admission notices, etc.); * 5. Non-Chinese native speakers needto provide Chinese proficiency proof (exempted with HSK 4 or above). * 6. Highest degree certificate or expected graduation proof (original): (1) Graduating high school students submit proof of expected high school graduation (issued by the high school issuing the graduation certificate); (2) Graduated high school students submit the high school graduation certificate; (3) Curent university students, in addition to the high school graduation certificate, also need to provide a curent enrollment certificate from their university. (4) Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 7. Oficial transcripts from the highest degree-granting institution (original) Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 8. Certificate of no criminal record * 9. Economic Proof(bank balance or certificate) Bank deposits should be more than RMB 20,000, should be issued within the last 2 months. * 10. Foreigner's physical examination certificate * 11. Personal statement Including self-introduction, educational experiences and study plan * 12. Music Videos (I) Music Performance 1. Written materials • Personal Resume (CV) • A 2-3 page English self-introduction essay, which should include: ①Understanding of "What Does It Mean to Become a Musician" ② Career goals and implementation plans for the next five years ③ Understanding of Chengdu, China culture and social values, and its impact on the realization of personal goals • Two recommendation letters • Previous performance repertoire list 2. Music video material (1) Content Requirements ① Violin direction (no need to memorize the score) a. Any major and any minor 3 octaves scale with arpeggios b. One etude/caprice (select from the following): - F. Kreutzer, 42 Etudes for Violin(Egelhoff edition): 17, - P. Rode, 24 Caprices for Solo Violin: 2, 4, 6, or 9, - J. Dont, Etudes Op.35: 2, 3, or 6 c. One self-selected showpiece piece (with accompaniment if available) ② Cello direction (no need to memorize the score) a. Any major and any minor 3 octaves scale with arpeggios b. One etude/caprice to select from: - D. Popper, Highschool of Cello Playing, Op. 73 - A.C. Piatti, 12 Caprices for Solo Cello, Op. 25 c. One prelude and one other movement from Bach Suite No. 1, 2 or 3 d. One movement of a standard concerto ③ Piano direction (requiring memorization) a. One Virtuoso Etude (i.e.:Moszkowski or F. Chopin Etudes) b. First movement (Sonata-Allegro) of any Sonata from the Classical period c. One polyphonic work by J. S. Bach to select from: - Sinfonias / Three-part Inventions - Prelude and Fugue from Well-Tempered Klavier Book I and II - Two contrasting Baroque dances / movements from any of the French Suites, English Suites or Partitas d. Any major work (one movement of complete-set work) from the Romantic period or 20th Century that best reflects your performing skills ④ Vocal direction Submit two art songs or arias in different languages, from the following four languages: a. English b. Italian c. German or French d. Chinese or native language (2) Video technology specifications ① The music videos must be complete scores with a full-length shot. The sound and image of the video should be recorded simultaneously. The videos must not be edited by the means such as conversion， cutting， clipping, and embellishing. ② A light-coloured background should be used during the recording; the record shall start from the candidate's front face (like the ID photo) and then pull to the full-body view. The video picture should be stable with a clear view of the applicant. ③ The applicant shall be the only person in the video. Accompaniment personnel, suggestive text, pattern, logo, background, or other personal information (the Name, place of origin and school of the candidate, etc.) are not allowed to appear in the video. ④ The number of videos is limited to 1 (two works are in the same video), the format is specified to WMV, MP4, AVI, MOV, make sure the sound and image are transparent. The file size is less than 300MB. ⑤ Any violation of any above provisions shall be deemed a breach and may result in disqualification from the preliminary examination. ⑥Please send the video to the specified E-mail: ioccaa@cdu.edu.cn. Please name the e-mail by the order: Name+Program(bachelor or master)+Major+Passport Number (3) Handling of violations Any violation of the above provisions will be considered a breach of rules and result in disqualification from the preliminary examination. (II) Dance Performance 1. Basic conditions •Height requirement: No less than 150cm for women and 170cm for men •Professional foundation: Possess dance fundamentals and can perform flexibility exercises including vertical splits, horizontal splits, and standing backbends. • Health status: physical and mental health, no physical problems that hinder dance performance 2. Video requirements • Content: Submit two solo dance video clips, each lasting at least 5 minutes (excluding street dance and ballroom dance). • Recording requirements: ① Venue: Dance rehearsal hall or stage theater ② Clothing: Training or performance attire ③Recording: Panoramic view, stable footage, synchronized music recording, no post-editing or beautification • Format and size: WMV, MP4, AVI, MOV. The file size should not exceed 300 MB. • Submission method: Send to email ioccaa@cdu.edu.cn, email subject: name - undergraduate - dance performance - passport number 3. Handling of violations Any violation of the above provisions will be considered a breach of rules and result in disqualification from the preliminary examination. Note: Upon enrollment, the School of Music and Dance will administer a professional competency test for 2026 international undergraduate students. If the test performance does not match the submitted application materials, or if plagiarism or falsification is detected, the school will initiate the expulsion process. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
